content: drizzle-orm/neon-http + @neondatabase/serverless neon() gives an HTTP-based Postgres connection (no TCP pool) that works correctly in Vercel serverless/edge functions; standard column types (jsonb, uuid.defaultRandom(), text, timestamp.defaultNow()) and index() in the pgTable third-arg callback for indexing a text column. Cross-checked via direct WebFetch of orm.drizzle.team's column-types, indexes-constraints and vercel-edge-functions tutorial pages.
